english: Pay {amount} to WASAC from your MTN Mobile Money, then tell us the transaction ID.
kinyarwanda: Ishyura {amount} kuri WASAC ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money, hanyuma utubwire nimero y'igikorwa.

english: 1. Dial this code and enter your MoMo PIN
kinyarwanda: 1. Kanda iyi kode hanyuma winjize umubare w'ibanga wa MoMo

english: Use WASAC's MoMo Pay merchant code from your bill, or ask WASAC on 1580.
kinyarwanda: Koresha kode ya MoMo Pay ya WASAC iri kuri fagitire yawe, cyangwa ubaze WASAC kuri 1580.

english: It is in the SMS MTN sends after you pay, for example 12345678901.
kinyarwanda: Iri mu butumwa MTN yohereza nyuma yo kwishyura, urugero 12345678901.

english: Enter the transaction ID exactly as it is in MTN's SMS (letters and numbers).
kinyarwanda: Andika nimero y'igikorwa uko iri mu butumwa bwa MTN (inyuguti n'imibare).

english: WASAC is matching transaction {id} ({amount}) with its MoMo account. Your bill shows as paid once it is confirmed, and you will get an SMS.
kinyarwanda: WASAC irimo guhuza igikorwa {id} ({amount}) na konti yayo ya MoMo. Fagitire izagaragara ko yishyuwe nimara kwemezwa, kandi uzabona SMS.

english: MoMo Pay payments waiting for a check. Find each transaction ID in WASAC's MoMo merchant account before confirming.
kinyarwanda: Ubwishyu bwa MoMo Pay butegereje kugenzurwa. Shaka buri nimero y'igikorwa muri konti ya WASAC ya MoMo mbere yo kwemeza.

english: No payments are waiting for a check.
Confirmed {amount} from {name}. The bill is paid.
Declined the payment from {name}. They have been told by SMS.
kinyarwanda: Ubwishyu bwa {name} bwanzwe. Bamenyeshejwe kuri SMS.

english: To check: open WASAC's MoMo merchant account (portal or statement), find the transaction ID and the amount, then confirm. With the MoMo API connected, payments are confirmed by MTN automatically and never wait here.
kinyarwanda: Uko bigenzurwa: fungura konti ya WASAC ya MoMo (portal cyangwa raporo), shaka nimero y'igikorwa n'amafaranga, hanyuma wemeze. Iyo MoMo API ihujwe, MTN yemeza ubwishyu ubwayo kandi ntibutegerereza hano.
